review_notes: I reviewed all 76 lines. I also read the definitions this file builds on in SheafChangeOfRings.lean and PresheafChangeOfRingsSymmetry.lean: moduleSheafification, tensorSheafFunctor, Sheaves, and rightPresheafFunctor. I searched Mathlib's ModuleCat/Sheaf directory for extendScalars and found no scalar-extension functor for sheaves of modules, so nothing there competes with rightSheafFunctor or rightSheafNatIso. moduleSheafification is a named wrapper around Mathlib's PresheafOfModules.sheafification, which is a useful specialisation. rightSheafFunctor is a composite of existing functors, and rightSheafNatIso is built from isoWhiskerLeft and isoWhiskerRight. The naturality theorem is stated for this project's own functors. opensRightSheafNatIso only supplies instances for the open-set site. I found no competing concept that is independent and avoidable.
